Title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
Authors: Shunyu Yao, Dian Yu, Jeffrey Zhao, Izhak Shafran, Thomas L. Griffiths,
         Yuan Cao, Karthik Narasimhan
Year: 2023
Venue: NeurIPS 2023

Abstract:
Tree of Thoughts extends chain-of-thought prompting by allowing language models
to explore multiple intermediate reasoning branches and evaluate them before
choosing the next step.

Key Findings:
- Strong gains on planning-style tasks
- Enables backtracking and deliberate search
- Improves performance on Game of 24 and creative writing

Methodology:
The method defines coherent “thoughts” as search units and uses the language
model for both candidate generation and state evaluation.
